author: reek
body: A constructor whose payload is moded Reals, returned from `opening`, which is the second of the two walks that matched `RealTy` alone.

author: reek
body: `emit-opening-print-field` had the same gap as the result walk and a worse failure: its tail is `otherwise -> emit-inline-itoa-and-print`, so a field that was not the default Real did not print nothing -- it printed its BIT PATTERN through the integer path. A plausible number, in the right place, with nothing to say it was wrong.

author: reek
body: The f32 field is the one that needs the width convert. `__real_to_text` reads sixty-four bits, so a single handed to it straight is read as a double and renders as a number nobody computed.

author: reek
body: IT HAS TO BE A CONSTRUCTOR RATHER THAN A RECORD. `emit-opening-result-print` has no `RecordTy` arm at all, so an `opening` returning a record falls to the same silent tail and prints nothing whatever its fields are -- measured, after this test was first written with a record and produced no output. The field walk is reached from the sum printer, so a sum is what reaches it.
